author: Sulaiman01z
quote: Losing core architects like Dan Houser and Leslie Benzies risks turning GTA 6 from a ruthless cultural disruptor into an over-budgeted, corporate-safe theme park built to funnel players into online monetization. Without the original creative teeth and sharp satirical edge, the game could trade unforgettable storytelling, systemic ambition, and biting social critique for glossy visuals, repetitive mission loops, and sanitized humor designed not to offend shareholders
